'''DarthVader,AOE Player's Preconstruct Deck 2: Disorder in Jabbas Court''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthVader,AOE]]
* '''Published:''' 13 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile DarthVader,AOE DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hope no-one minds the name I gave this deck-I'm such a knucklehead.

The published list has 57 cards.
